name: Phuket
tagline: Island resort conventions & Andaman catamaran charters
intro: Integrated 5-star resort complexes in Laguna Phuket offering ballrooms, private beach access, and island-hopping corporate charters.
access: Flights from Delhi, usually with one stop.
highlights: Resort properties that hold a conference and a gala on site, with a beach the group does not have to travel to.
Stronger reward value than Bangkok or Pattaya when the trip is explicitly a prize.
Island setting reads as a significant upgrade on a domestic beach offsite.
planning_note: The monsoon from May to October brings rough seas and cancelled water activities. Connections are also longer than Bangkok, so budget a travel day at each end.
